observed_effect: No demonstrated selector advantage. The selector is deterministic and did pick its own top-ranked task for this slot, but the improvement the evidence basis attributes to it (five frontier cells closed without equivalent retests) was produced before this campaign existed by a different mechanism: the research-side frontier discipline, the per-cell gate stack, and paired independent verifiers. The selector has 1 observed selection and 0 outcome records, and its qualitative discrimination is coarse (6 LEARNING_PROCESS tasks collapse to 5 distinct rank tuples; the P-003/P-006 tie is broken by task_id, not by value). Dedup is also definitional rather than measured: three post-adoption cells re-tested the momentum family and 4 of 5 open research tasks qualify the same admitted candidate under the 'different information objective' exception. The concrete effect of this activation is therefore a record-accuracy correction plus a re-runnable audit path, not a measured throughput gain.
uncertainty_targeted: Whether explicit highest-value focused-task selection measurably improves information flow over opportunistic task choice, and whether the repository's cited dedup evidence is attributable to the selector at all.
uncertainty_reduced: Attribution uncertainty resolved: the cited evidence cannot test the selector (it predates the campaign and belongs to another mechanism), the selector's selection was reproduced exactly from its own ranking function, its discriminating power and tie behaviour are now quantified, and the dedup claim is shown to be definitional. Residual uncertainty (whether the selector improves realized outcomes) is untouched and requires per-slot outcome records across the full campaign.
research_result: NO DEMONSTRATED SELECTOR ADVANTAGE, and the cited evidence is misattributed. The focused-task selector is retained as cheap deterministic infrastructure (it is reproducible, cannot be gamed by queue order, and correctly ranked this slot first), but its efficiency claim is reclassified UNVERIFIED, and the learning record now requires mechanism attribution before any selector is credited. Secondary process finding: the current research queue spends 4 of 5 open research slots qualifying a single admitted candidate, so even a perfectly discriminating selector cannot by itself deliver search diversification.
